question: What is the meaning of re-use potentials in relation to physical?
description: Re-use potentials refer to the capacity of materials to be reused in their original form or in a new application, thereby reducing the need for new raw materials and minimizing waste. This concept is crucial in sustainable construction as it promotes the circular economy by extending the lifecycle of materials and reducing environmental impact. In the context of material passports, re-use potentials are assessed to guide users in selecting materials that can be effectively reused, contributing to more sustainable building practices.
